title: `Core\Server` has no request environment, which the spec lists for it.
text: Spec § 15 gives `Core\Server` the request's own environment, which replaces `$_SERVER` (`docs/spec/01-core-library.md:1161`), and names no member for it. `traceId()` is built. `Core\Request` and `Core\Env` already cover most of `$_SERVER`, so which members are still owed is a question in the goal prose's § *Questions for the user at the goal end*. The module doc names the gap (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/server.rs:12`). Closing this builds the answer, removes the sentence from the module doc, and deletes this record.
